summary: A followed conversation finds its owner and transcript once per open rather than again on its first wait

replay.detail: No claim admission or replay changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes or persistent state. The follower keeps its conversation mark in memory.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged; no coordinated member upgrade is required.

compatibility.detail: Conversation frames, cursors, replay and relay are unchanged. A follower reuses the owner and transcript it found for one follow wait (10 seconds), as long as a single wait already reused them, then finds them again, so a harness that moves to a new transcript is still followed within the same bound.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or interruption beyond a normal daemon restart.

manual.detail: No operator action or client configuration change is needed.

recovery.detail: No persistent changes or new binary swap-back restrictions.
